data.description: Shaped like a seahorse and finished in Lemon Yellow, this spring rider brings a sea theme to a toddler play area. A child sits on the seahorse, holds on and rocks it on its spring. The curled tail and upright head make it one of the more unusual characters in our spring rider range. It suits play schools, nurseries, resorts and society gardens that want something less common than a horse or duck. Spring riders keep small children close to the ground while they practise balance. The roto-moulded seahorse carries our 3-year warranty, and the spring is warranted for 1 year. Send us your site photos for a layout suggestion.

items.pText: Shaped like a seahorse and finished in Lemon Yellow, this spring rider brings a sea theme to a toddler play area. A child sits on the seahorse, holds on and rocks it on its spring. The curled tail and upright head make it one of the more unusual characters in our spring rider range. It suits play schools, nurseries, resorts and society gardens that want something less common than a horse or duck. Spring riders keep small children close to the ground while they practise balance. The roto-moulded seahorse carries our 3-year warranty, and the spring is warranted for 1 year. Send us your site photos for a layout suggestion.

The seahorse body is roto-moulded and the spring is steel. Our installers fix it self-standing or grouted in. Leave clear space round the rider for its rocking movement, lay rubber flooring below, and check the spring and handholds as part of regular maintenance.
